headline: OpenAI doubles down on decision to fire three AI safety researchers
summary: OpenAI fired three safety researchers for a "significant breach of trust." The company defended its decision, citing policy violations on sensitive information. Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak, and Mikita Balesni were dismissed.

headline: Microsoft 365 Family subscribers will finally be able to share AI benefits
summary: Microsoft 365 Family subscribers can now share Copilot and AI features. Previously, only the primary account holder could access AI benefits. This update also includes sharing Office apps and OneDrive storage.

headline: US plans livestream of execution by firing squad
summary: The US plans to livestream the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan. Defense Department officials confirmed the unprecedented livestream. Hasan, convicted of 13 murders, is scheduled for execution by firing squad.

headline: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
summary: Anthropic introduced OSS Scanner for free AI security scans on open-source projects. The service uses strong AI models to identify vulnerabilities. It offers early alerts for security issues, with data sharing as a trade-off.

headline: The Best LEGO Castle Sets to Build in 2026
summary: Discover the top LEGO castle sets available now for builders. The list includes themed sets from Lord of the Rings and Disney. Perfect for those looking to construct epic castles.

headline: The Most Expensive Lego Sets You Can Buy in 2026
summary: Explore the most costly LEGO sets currently on the market. This guide highlights the investment required for serious LEGO collectors. It confirms that playing with LEGOs can be an expensive hobby.

headline: Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade Drops to New All-Time Low Price on Switch 2
summary: Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade is now available for just $25 on Nintendo Switch 2. This price marks a new all-time low for the game. No Amazon Prime membership is required to access this deal.

headline: Every Legend of Zelda LEGO Set Released So Far
summary: A comprehensive list of all released LEGO The Legend of Zelda sets. Despite few sets, the existing collection is described as epic. A must-read for fans of both Zelda and LEGO.

headline: Polanski vows to stay on as Green leader as criticism mounts after by-election defeat
summary: Green leader Polanski committed to remaining in his position. He faces growing criticism after a recent by-election defeat. Calls for his resignation have surfaced amid a Zionism row.

headline: 'Deeply personal moment': Watch Sagal Abdi-Wali's by-election victory speech
summary: Sagal Abdi-Wali delivered an emotional victory speech after her by-election win. Labour defeated the Green Party, securing 45% of the vote. The victory took place in the Holborn and St Pancras constituency.

headline: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
summary: France's education minister offered 3,000 new teachers to address student unrest. This move aims to calm ongoing, sometimes violent, student protests. It represents an initial step towards fulfilling student demands.

headline: King pays Andrew's £1.5m repair bill on Royal Lodge
summary: King Charles covered Prince Andrew's £1.5 million repair bill for Royal Lodge. Andrew surrendered the lease on the 30-room mansion. The payment covered significant repair and restoration costs.
